newsitem.title: USA: MedPlus Corp says Harding is new CFO.
newsitem.headline: MedPlus Corp says Harding is new CFO.

text.p: MedPlus Corp said on Wednesday that James Harding had become the company's new chief financial officer and vice president of finance, succeeding chief financial officer Robert Ryman.
Harding's background includes a seven year tenure with Excell Inc, during which he served as senior vice president and chief financial officer, Medplus said in a statement.
Before joining Excell, Harding spent six years as chief financial officer for Peak Health Care Inc, the company added.
"Jim's background and qualifications bring us a significant strength to our management team," said MedPlus president Tim DeHerrera.
MedPlus is a health finance organization located in Colorado Springs, Colorado.
